player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} ({piece}) achi. Birodhi achi ({opp}).
Gatividhi '[a2 a3]' (teke → okare) rupre de.
- Ek sammanya gatividhi ek agu paila ek pasey khali vertex te.
- Ek dhara ek pasey satru piece pare khali node te.
Pratyek dhara {score_per_capture} point dey.
Khela ses {max_moves} gatividhi pachhe ba ki jodi ek player kono nyayik gatividhi na thake.
